files=(
  "/bench/repo/server/auth/authenticator.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/notification/email.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go"
  "/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go"
  "/bench/repo/store/user_setting.go"
)

for file in "${files[@]}"; do
  if [ -f "$file" ]; then
    awk -v f="$file" '/^func.*\(/ {func=$0} /\.GetUser\(/ && !/GetUserBy/ {print func " — " f}' "$file"

done
